gate: H1b-1b-2 corrected c_gamma error normalization and Lemma 8.4 route decision
scope: A fail-closed decomposition of the additional proof needed after the peer-reviewed correction to the GGPY/Maynard c_gamma-normalized error. This ledger does not prove a numerical lower bound, choose a successful repair route, certify Maynard Lemma 8.4, or compute X_cert.

source_registry.title: Dense Clusters of Primes in Subsets
Bounded gaps between primes in number fields and function fields
source_registry.reviewed_locations: PDF page 11, Lemma 2.5 and following remark and proof

source_registry.title: Sums of singular series with large sets and the tail of the distribution of primes

status_vocabulary.PRINTED_EXACT_STRUCTURE: The source prints the exact algebraic structure, but it is not yet a numerical bound.
status_vocabulary.PARAMETERIZED_EXPLICIT: An exact propagation formula is proved once named positive numerical inputs are supplied.
status_vocabulary.RATE_MISSING: At least one multiplier, exponent constant, or finite range remains implicit.
status_vocabulary.SPECIALIZATION_REQUIRED: A result for a special sieve function has not been proved uniformly for Maynard's actual functions.
status_vocabulary.HARD_BLOCKER: No route can be promoted until all upstream bounds and a common range are numerical.

obligations.role: identify the one-dimensional multiplicative function at iteration j
obligations.printed_information: gamma_j(p)=0 if p divides W_{j+1} product_{i=j+2}^r e_i, and otherwise gamma_j(p)=p/(1+n_j(p)+g(p)).
missing_numeric_inputs: the first uniform k and R range

obligations.role: express the Euler product whose lower bound is needed
obligations.printed_information: c_gamma_j=product_p (1-gamma_j(p)/p)^(-1)(1-1/p), and Maynard gives the exact identity linking c_j c_gamma_j to c_{j+1} and g_j/g_{j+1}.
missing_numeric_inputs: uniform lower control of every local factor
a finite truncation and tail error

obligations.locator: excluded primes in c_gamma_j; W_i contains every p<=2k^2
obligations.role: lower-bound the product of (1-1/p) over mandatory small excluded primes
missing_numeric_inputs: an explicit Mertens or totient-product lower bound with finite cutoff
compatibility with the chosen k range

obligations.role: lower-bound factors from prime divisors of W_{j+1} product e_i above 2k^2
obligations.printed_information: The proof only states that the relevant integer is at most R^(O(k^2)) and that its prime-divisor harmonic sum is O(log log R).
missing_numeric_inputs: an explicit lower bound for the corresponding finite Euler product
uniformity in j and the remaining e_i

obligations.role: lower-bound the convergent product over nonexcluded primes
obligations.printed_information: For nonexcluded primes gamma_j(p)=1+O(k/p), but the O multiplier is not printed.
missing_numeric_inputs: an explicit local-factor lower bound from g(p)

obligations.role: produce one positive c_min valid at every Lemma 8.4 iteration
obligations.printed_information: If c_gamma_j>=c_min>0 uniformly, the corrected absolute Lemma 4 error converts to a relative multiplier 2*C3_abs/c_min.

obligations.role: alternative route restoring a c_gamma-relative error by making z sufficiently large compared with L and k
obligations.printed_information: The special prime-tuple result assumes L<=log(z)/B_L and k^2<=log(z)/B_k and has relative error O((L+k^4)/log z).
missing_numeric_inputs: a proof for every Maynard gamma_j rather than only nu_H

obligations.role: choose a proved lower-bound, size-gate, or direct multivariate repair without mixing hypotheses
obligations.printed_information: The lower-bound and size-gate routes are sufficient in principle; a direct absolute-error multivariate proof is a third possible route.
missing_numeric_inputs: at least one fully numerical route
a comparison of the resulting error loss and cutoff

obligations.role: redo the j=0 to r induction and binomial error accumulation with the corrected normalization
obligations.printed_information: The printed proof uses c_j*c_gamma_j factorization at every step and then replaces the binomial error by O(j epsilon).
missing_numeric_inputs: a numerical smallness condition for the binomial accumulation

next_gate.recommended: Derive explicit local-factor bounds for Maynard's actual gamma_j and determine whether c_gamma_j has a usable uniform lower bound before investing in the full Kuperberg/HR constant reconstruction.
next_gate.parallel: Trace explicit Mertens/totient-product bounds and quantify the Kuperberg recurrence constants.
